achievements.name: Enter Service
achievements.detail: Join a daimyo's household and take a retainer's rank.

achievements.name: Council Order
achievements.detail: Accept an order at the council and report it finished later.

achievements.name: Skill Training
achievements.detail: Raise a combat or command skill through practice the clan assigns.

achievements.name: Field Victory
achievements.detail: Win a field battle against another clan's army.

achievements.name: Siege Victory
achievements.detail: Win a siege and capture the castle that was holding out.

achievements.name: Personal Duel
achievements.detail: Win a personal combat, whether a duel or a clash with bandits.

achievements.name: Recruit an Officer
achievements.detail: Complete a recruitment and add an officer to the clan.

achievements.name: Alliance Made
achievements.detail: Carry out a diplomatic order that seals an alliance with another clan.

achievements.name: Develop the Domain
achievements.detail: Finish a domestic order that improves fields, a mine, or a castle's defenses.

achievements.name: Castle Lord
achievements.detail: Rise by merit until the clan names you lord of a castle.

achievements.name: Province Lord
achievements.detail: Advance further and take charge of more than one castle.

achievements.name: Realm United
achievements.detail: Expand a clan's domain until the scenario counts the realm as unified.
